newsitem.title: GREECE: FORECAST-Avg bids on Greek FRN/bond seen100.2/98.7.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Avg bids on Greek FRN/bond seen100.2/98.7.

text.p: Greece's auction of seven-year FRNs and three-year fixed coupon bond will produce average bids of 100.20 and 98.70, respectively, bankers, mutual fund managers and brokers predicted in an informal poll by Reuters.
The poll participants were asked to forecast the average bid for the FRN and the three-year bond at the auction. The results of the poll follow:
RANGE OF AVG BIDS AVG BID
A few mutual fund managers said they would either not bid for the three-year bond or they would bid for the bond only in small sums.

Greece will auction 200 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters with the benchmark 12-month T-bill set at 12 percent for the first year and the spread set at 140 basis points over it and 100 billion drachmas of three-year, 11 percent coupon bond on Friday. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
